svg.aria-label: Left: fraction of simulated studies whose interval mean plus or minus 1.96 s over root n misses the true mean. Uniform data are on target by n equal 30 (below that the 1.96 multiplier itself is too small); exponential data are close by n equal 100; log-normal data with sigma 1.5 still miss about 7 percent of the time at n equal 3000. Right: almost all log-normal misses are intervals that sit entirely below the true mean
